title: Being Your Years
label: ch:ge-alter
canDo: I can ask how old somebody is and say my own age in German, using the verb German insists on for it.

payoff.summary: This material was the second half of the hand-written haben chapter, and it could not stay there: ich bin zwanzig Jahre alt needs ich bin, and Wie alt bist du? needs du bist — both of which the chapter on sein teaches. It sits here instead, immediately after that chapter, where every word it needs is already owned, and it closes the haben chapter's open question by showing the one everyday sentence where German refuses that verb.
